text:
Your biggest problem isn't laziness. It's being too vague.

You want success. You want money. You want to matter.

You sound like every other man with nothing.

The man who moves doesn't want success. He wants 100k revenue by March selling this with his partner.

That's not hope. That's a target.

A wish is 'get strong.' A target is '30 pushups at 5 a.m.'

One is just feeling. One builds muscle.

Write it down. When. How much. With who. Doing what.

Be so specific it scares you.

Your brain hunts what it sees. Stop making it guess.
caption:
Vague wishes get vague results. Precision gets action.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
